scope: tracked root-level test*.js and test*.sh runners

statusPolicy.active: explicitly listed in package.json, test-all.sh, .github/workflows/deploy.yml, AGENTS.md, or README.md
statusPolicy.dormant: absent from all five runner/documentation surfaces

classificationPolicy.unit: isolated assertions, source/DOM checks, or VM tests without a live browser/server
classificationPolicy.integration: runner that invokes another repository test/tool boundary
classificationPolicy.e2e: imports Playwright and drives browser behavior; filename alone is not classification evidence
